description.en: Synthetic coronary and cardiorenal cases with inpatient PCI and follow-up.
description.zh: 合成心血管与心肾病例，覆盖住院介入及随访。

display.zh: 冠状动脉粥样硬化性心脏病

packageInsertSummary.en: Antiplatelet. Check bleeding and aspirin intolerance.
packageInsertSummary.zh: 抗血小板药，核对出血及阿司匹林不耐受史。

packageInsertSummary.en: P2Y12 inhibitor. Review active bleeding and co-medication.
packageInsertSummary.zh: P2Y12 抑制剂，核对活动性出血及合并用药。

packageInsertSummary.en: Review bleeding, dyspnea and other antiplatelets.
packageInsertSummary.zh: 核对出血、气促及其他抗血小板药。

packageInsertSummary.en: Monitor lipids, liver function and muscle symptoms.
packageInsertSummary.zh: 复核血脂、肝功能及肌肉症状。

packageInsertSummary.en: Review renal function and statin-associated muscle symptoms.
packageInsertSummary.zh: 核对肾功能及他汀相关肌肉症状。

packageInsertSummary.en: Lipid-lowering adjunct. Reassess LDL response.
packageInsertSummary.zh: 调脂辅助药物，随访低密度脂蛋白变化。

packageInsertSummary.en: Check blood pressure, potassium, renal function and angioedema history.
packageInsertSummary.zh: 核对血压、血钾、肾功及血管性水肿史。

packageInsertSummary.en: Review blood pressure, potassium and renal function.
packageInsertSummary.zh: 核对血压、血钾及肾功能。

packageInsertSummary.en: Review ACE inhibitor washout, other ARBs and blood pressure.
packageInsertSummary.zh: 核对 ACEI 停药间隔、其他 ARB 及血压。

display.zh: 琥珀酸美托洛尔缓释片

packageInsertSummary.en: Review pulse, blood pressure and conduction disorders.
packageInsertSummary.zh: 核对脉搏、血压及传导障碍。

packageInsertSummary.en: Review hypotension, formulation and interacting vasodilators.
packageInsertSummary.zh: 核对低血压、剂型及血管扩张药相互作用。

packageInsertSummary.en: Verify concentration, coagulation, platelet count and bleeding.
packageInsertSummary.zh: 确认浓度、凝血指标、血小板及出血。

packageInsertSummary.en: Review weight, renal function and bleeding risk.
packageInsertSummary.zh: 核对体重、肾功能及出血风险。

packageInsertSummary.en: Check volume status and electrolytes with peri-procedural hydration.
packageInsertSummary.zh: 围术期水化时核对容量状态及电解质。

packageInsertSummary.en: Monitor volume, electrolytes and renal function.
packageInsertSummary.zh: 监测容量、电解质与肾功能。

packageInsertSummary.en: Monitor potassium and renal function.
packageInsertSummary.zh: 监测血钾与肾功能。

packageInsertSummary.en: Assess renal function for the indication and review peri-operative use.
packageInsertSummary.zh: 结合适应证核对肾功能及围手术期用药。

packageInsertSummary.en: Review influenza indication and renal dosing.
packageInsertSummary.zh: 核对流感适应证与肾功相关剂量。

packageInsertSummary.en: Review bacterial indication and immediate penicillin allergy.
packageInsertSummary.zh: 核对细菌感染依据及青霉素速发型过敏史。

packageInsertSummary.en: Check liver disease and total intake from combination products.
packageInsertSummary.zh: 核对肝病史及复方制剂中的累计用量。

packageInsertSummary.en: Review eGFR and contrast exposure around interventions.
packageInsertSummary.zh: 介入前后核对 eGFR 与对比剂暴露。

packageInsertSummary.en: Check blood pressure and peripheral edema.
packageInsertSummary.zh: 核对血压及外周水肿。

guidelineTopics.verbatim: 治疗原则为达标、平稳、综合管理。以血压达标为首要治疗目标，除非不能耐受；保持血压长期稳定；积极控制其他心血管危险因素。
qualifiers: 第 8.1 条，基层医疗卫生机构高血压管理；个体耐受性与其他心血管危险因素须并行评估。

openingStatement.en: Walking makes my chest tight. My kidneys have been weak for years.
openingStatement.zh: 最近一走路胸口就发闷气短，我肾功能本来就不太好。

symptoms.en: After about 200 metres I stop to catch my breath.
symptoms.zh: 走两百米左右就气短，歇几分钟缓解。

symptoms.en: I have known about chronic kidney disease stage 3 for two years.
symptoms.zh: 以前医生说过慢性肾脏病3期，已经两年多。

medicationMemory.en: I take one amlodipine tablet daily.
medicationMemory.zh: 我每天按时吃一片氨氯地平。

boundaries.en: Describe the kidney problem as previously explained to you.
boundaries.zh: 只讲过去医生告知的肾脏问题。

hiddenHistory.en: No recent use of analgesics or herbal remedies.
hiddenHistory.zh: 近期没有自行服用止痛药或中草药。

summary.en: Sinus rhythm at 74/min, no significant ST-T abnormalities.
summary.zh: 窦性心律 74 次/分，未见明显 ST-T 异常。
左室射血分数 56%，舒张功能 I 级减低。

summary.en: Mid LAD 85%, FFR 0.74, TIMI 3. QCA length 14 mm with 3.0 mm reference diameters.
summary.zh: 前降支中段狭窄 85%，FFR 0.74，TIMI 3 级。病变长 14 mm，两端参考直径均为 3.0 mm。

reviewPoints.en: Review kidney protection, contrast burden and serial creatinine. Match one 3.0 × 18 mm teaching stent to the measured lesion.
reviewPoints.zh: 核对肾脏保护、对比剂负荷与复查肌酐，根据造影测量匹配一枚 3.0 × 18 mm 教学支架。

openingStatement.en: If I walk fast my chest feels tight.
openingStatement.zh: 我最近走路快了偶尔胸口发闷，想检查清楚。

symptoms.en: It settles when I sit down for two or three minutes.
symptoms.zh: 提重物或快走时发闷，坐下两三分钟就好。

medicationMemory.en: I take amlodipine in the morning.
medicationMemory.zh: 每天按时吃氨氯地平一片。

boundaries.en: Explain the symptoms you have noticed.

hiddenHistory.en: No rest symptoms or nocturnal breathlessness.

summary.en: Sinus rhythm, 72/min. No significant ST-T abnormality.
summary.zh: 窦性心律 72 次/分，未见明显 ST-T 异常。
左室功能正常，射血分数 62%。

summary.en: Mid LAD 60% with FFR 0.86 and TIMI 3 flow.
summary.zh: 前降支中段临界狭窄 60%，FFR 0.86，TIMI 3 级。

reviewPoints.en: FFR > 0.80 in this borderline lesion supports deferring stenting and reviewing medical therapy.
reviewPoints.zh: 本例临界病变 FFR > 0.80，质控提示暂缓支架，复核药物优化方案。

openingStatement.en: My chest has felt tight on and off since dawn and I keep sweating.
openingStatement.zh: 我今天凌晨起胸口一阵阵发闷发紧，刚才走路又冒汗。

symptoms.en: Pressure spreads towards my left shoulder.

medicationMemory.zh: 每天早上吃一片氨氯地平。

boundaries.en: Describe your symptoms and the medicines you remember.
boundaries.zh: 描述真实感受及记得的用药。

hiddenHistory.en: Repeated pressure lasted about ten minutes per episode.
hiddenHistory.zh: 反复压榨感，每次约十分钟。

summary.en: Horizontal ST depression 0.15–0.20 mV with T inversion in V2–V5.
summary.zh: V2–V5 水平型 ST 段压低 0.15–0.20 mV 伴 T 波倒置。
高敏肌钙蛋白 I 0.68 ng/mL。

summary.en: Culprit proximal LAD 90%, TIMI 2. Lesion length 15 mm, 3.0 mm reference diameters.
summary.zh: 罪犯病变为前降支近段 90% 狭窄、TIMI 2 级，长 15 mm，两端参考直径 3.0 mm。
随访高敏肌钙蛋白 I 0.012 ng/mL。

reviewPoints.en: Recognize high-risk chest pain and dynamic myocardial injury, then reassess after PCI.
reviewPoints.zh: 识别高危胸痛和动态心肌损伤，介入后复查并安排随访。
